meiFaq.title: Frequently asked questions
meiFaq.subtitle: Common questions—if you don’t see yours, reach out on WhatsApp!

items.a: It’s a page built around one clear goal: a lead, a sale, or a signup. It works well for ads, Instagram, and short campaigns, without needing a full multi-page site on day one.

items.q: What does the green banner promotion mean?
items.a: It describes hosting and use of our domain at no extra charge for one year under the commercial terms we agree. Details (scope, your own domain vs. the domain included in the offer, renewal) are always confirmed in the quote and contract.

items.q: Can I use my own domain (e.g. .com or .com.br)?
items.a: Yes—most projects can point the site to a domain you already own or that we register for you. The banner describes the package with our domain; if you prefer your own, we align pricing and steps in the proposal.

items.q: Do I need a business registration or company number to hire you?
items.a: You can request a quote and scope the project without extra bureaucracy. For invoicing and a formal contract we agree whether it’s as a registered business, sole trader, or individual—whatever fits your situation.

items.q: How long until the page is live?
items.a: It depends on scope: a lean landing vs. integrations (forms, payments, CRM), copy, and review rounds. We give a realistic timeline in the proposal; tell us if you have a campaign or launch date so we can prioritize.

items.q: Will the landing page show up on Google?
items.a: We deliver a solid technical base for indexing and basic on-page SEO. Organic rankings take time and depend on competition. For faster results, landing pages plus paid traffic (Google, Meta, etc.).

items.q: What happens after the first year for hosting and domain?
items.a: Hosting and the domain become renewable under the plan and pricing we agree at that time. We’ll give you advance notice to avoid downtime; if you want to move to another provider later, we can help with migration.
